subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

All the guests were shocked at his ______ laughter.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Unrestrained"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• *Unrecognized-* not identified from previous encounters or knowledge.
 
• *Unrestrained- *not restrained or restricted.
 
• *Unresolved- *(of a problem, question, or dispute) not resolved.
 
• *Unremarkable- *not particularly interesting or surprising.
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is** Option 2 i.e. Unrestrained.**

**So the correct sentence is-** *All the guests were shocked at his **unrestrained** laughter.*
